name: DrivingGaussian
aliases: DrivingGaussian — A method that composites surrounding views from multiple cameras into a single dynamic scene, aligning the Gaussian clouds of different vehicles with their tracked trajectories.
definition: A method that composites surrounding views from multiple cameras into a single dynamic scene, aligning the Gaussian clouds of different vehicles with their tracked trajectories.
summary: DrivingGaussian reconstructs dynamic driving scenes by separating static and dynamic 3D Gaussians, aligning vehicle clouds with tracked trajectories, and leveraging LiDAR and SAM priors.
